p: Changzhou Sealdo Technologies Corporation is an innovative high-tech company that integrates the R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of rotary oil seals. Sealdo consistently adheres to a management philosophy of high standards, high requirements, high quality, and high efficiency. Life simulation analysis, force simulation analysis, and usage scenario validation analysis; low-friction rubber materials and scientific seal structure design; and high-precision mold design and manufacturing provide strong assurance for Sealdo's products. Rotary shaft lip seals are widely used in drones, pool robots, robotic vacuum cleaners, lawn mower robots, window-cleaning robots, humanoid robots, motors, kitchen appliances, and various types of automotive motors.
